services_heading: Plastering Services Across Bristol & South Gloucestershire

services.title: Internal Wall Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, level finishes to walls and ceilings in homes and commercial spaces. We prepare, plaster, and finish ready for decoration.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation & Taping
services.desc: Professional dry-lining for new partitions, extensions, and refurbishment. Includes jointing and finishing to any specification.

services.title: Artex Removal & Re-plaster
services.desc: Safe removal of textured finishes and replacement with modern, smooth plaster — ideal for period homes and updates.

services.title: Cement Rendering & External Work
services.desc: Durable exterior finishes that protect and enhance your property. Fully weatherproofed and colour-matched to suit.

services.title: Crack Repair & Making Good
services.desc: Identify and repair settlement cracks, impact damage, and structural movement. Restore walls to pristine condition.

services.title: New-Build & Extension Finishing
services.desc: Complete plaster packages for new properties and extensions, delivered on time and to specification.

about_pullquote: Proper plaster work shouldn't cost the earth or take forever.
about_para_1: Chew Valley Plastering was born from frustration — too many cowboys charging premium prices for rushed, sloppy finishes. I decided to do it differently: honest pricing, meticulous workmanship, and turn-up on time. Over 18 years, we've built our reputation one wall at a time across Bristol, South Gloucestershire, and the Chew Valley.
about_para_2: Word-of-mouth remains our strongest referral source because homeowners and builders know what they'll get: a plasterer who takes pride in the finish, respects your home, and doesn't disappear when the job's done. Whether it's a small repair or a new-build shell, we treat every project with the same care.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our whole downstairs replastered after damp work. Andy arrived when he said he would, got the job done in two days, and left the place spotless. Really pleased with the finish — smooth as glass. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Couldn't recommend highly enough. We needed our artex removed and the ceiling replastered, and he did it without fuss or mess. Fair price too. Now neighbours are asking for his number!
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: The plasterer we had before left cracks everywhere. Andy came in, sorted the lot, and gave us a proper finish. Professional and no unnecessary work or upselling. Dead honest bloke.
reviews.author: David L.
